The person asks:
Can I still object to the higher health insurance contribution? Until when?

response.text:
No — that deadline has passed. The objection (Widerspruch) to Muster BKK's contribution notice had to be posted by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** and received by **Wed 14 Oct 2026** [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg], and today is already Fri 30 Oct 2026, so that window is over.

A few notes:
- Even if you had objected, the letter states that an objection would not have suspended payment of the higher contribution anyway, per §86a SGG — so the increased amount is due regardless.
- The higher monthly contribution continues to be collected automatically; the next one is due Sun 15 Nov 2026 [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].
- If you still want to contest the assessment despite the deadline having passed, I'd suggest contacting Muster BKK directly to ask about your options, since this isn't something I can advise on further.
